title: Livelier Scorecard, tidier Research
items: Scorecard: the hit rate is drawn against its expected mark and 95% range, and Against the price sits on a scale centred on the 50% coin flip, with Market better and Matchday better on either side.
Scorecard: Against the market shows Agreed and Disagreed as hit-rate bars with an expected tick, in place of the table.
Research: Matchday results is removed (the Scorecard covers it), and Matchday in public now runs full width.
Research: team logos in Risers & fallers, Longshots that won, Reading the chart and the pick list. Footnotes now sit directly under their content.
